title: Campaign Name Generator
description: Create clean, consistent marketing campaign names — snake_case, kebab-case and UTM-ready variants from your inputs.
howto: Enter brand, campaign, channel and an optional date.
Get consistent names in snake_case, kebab-case, spaced and UTM-tag formats.
Copy any variant straight into your ad platform or analytics.

faqs.a: Consistent names keep ad platforms, analytics and spreadsheets aligned — "summer_sale" in one place and "Summer-Sale" in another splits your reporting.
A ready utm_campaign value (lowercase, underscore-separated) you can append to links for Google Analytics tracking.
snake_case for UTMs and file names, kebab-case for URLs, spaced Title Case for client-facing reports. This tool gives you all three.
